verses.en: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
verses.pt: Sede meus imitadores, assim como eu também sou de Cristo.
verses.en_web: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.
verses.en_bbe: So take me for your example, even as I take Christ for mine.

verses.en: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.
verses.pt: Eu vos louvo, irmãos, de que em tudo vos lembrais de mim, e retendes minhas ordens, assim como eu vos entreguei.
verses.en_web: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.
verses.en_bbe: Now I am pleased to see that you keep me in memory in all things, and that you give attention to the teaching which was handed down from me to you.

verses.en: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.
verses.pt: Mas quero que saibais, que a cabeça de todo homem é Cristo; e a cabeça da mulher é o homem; e a cabeça de Cristo é Deus.
verses.en_web: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
verses.en_bbe: But it is important for you to keep this fact in mind, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man, and the head of Christ is God.

verses.en: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
verses.pt: Todo homem que ora ou profetiza, tendo alguma coisa sobre a cabeça, desonra sua própria cabeça.
verses.en_web: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.
verses.en_bbe: Every man who takes part in prayer, or gives teaching as a prophet, with his head covered, puts shame on his head.

verses.en: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.
verses.pt: Mas toda mulher que ora ou profetiza com a cabeça descoberta, desonra sua própria cabeça; porque é o mesmo que se a tivesse raspada.
verses.en_web: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.
verses.en_bbe: But every woman who does so with her head unveiled, puts shame on her head: for it is the same as if her hair was cut off.

verses.en: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.
verses.pt: Porque se a mulher não se cobre, raspe-se também; mas se para a mulher é vergonhoso se cortar ou se raspar, que se cubra.
verses.en_web: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.
verses.en_bbe: For if a woman is not veiled, let her hair be cut off; but if it is a shame to a woman to have her hair cut off, let her be veiled.

verses.en: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
verses.pt: Porque o homem não deve cobrir a cabeça, pois é a imagem e a glória de Deus; mas a mulher é a glória do homem.
verses.en_web: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.
verses.en_bbe: For it is not right for a man to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.

verses.en: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.
verses.pt: Porque o homem não provem da mulher, mas sim a mulher do homem.
verses.en_web: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;
verses.en_bbe: For the man did not come from the woman, but the woman from the man.

verses.en: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.
verses.pt: Porque também o homem não foi criado por causa da mulher, mas a mulher foi criada por causa do homem.
verses.en_web: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.
verses.en_bbe: And the man was not made for the woman, but the woman for the man.

verses.en: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.
verses.pt: Portanto a mulher deve ter sobre a cabeça sinal de autoridade, por causa dos anjos.
verses.en_web: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason it is right for the woman to have a sign of authority on her head, because of the angels.

verses.en: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.
verses.pt: Porém, nem o homem é sem a mulher, nem a mulher sem o homem, no Senhor.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: But the woman is not separate from the man, and the man is not separate from the woman in the Lord.

verses.en: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.
verses.pt: Porque assim como a mulher vem do homem, assim também é o homem pela mulher; porém tudo vem de Deus.
verses.en_web: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.
verses.en_bbe: For as the woman is from the man, so the man is through the woman; but all things are from God.

verses.en: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?
verses.pt: Julgai-vos entre vós mesmos: é decente que a mulher ore a Deus descoberta?
verses.en_web: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?
verses.en_bbe: Be judges yourselves of the question: does it seem right for a woman to take part in prayer unveiled?

verses.en: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?
verses.pt: Ou não vos ensina a mesma natureza, que ter cabelo longo é desonra para o homem?
verses.en_web: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?
verses.en_bbe: Does it not seem natural to you that if a man has long hair, it is a cause of shame to him?

verses.en: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.
verses.pt: Mas a mulher ter cabelo longo, lhe é honra, porque os cabelos lhe são dados por cobertura?
verses.en_web: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.
verses.en_bbe: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given to her for a covering.

verses.en: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
verses.pt: Porém se alguém parece ser inclinado a disputas, nós não temos tal costume, nem as igrejas de Deus.
verses.en_web: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.
verses.en_bbe: But if any man will not be ruled in this question, this is not our way of doing things, and it is not done in the churches of God.

verses.en: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.
verses.pt: Mas isto eu vos declaro, que não vos louvo, porque vós vos ajuntais, não para melhor, mas para pior.
verses.en_web: But in giving you this command, I don’t praise you, that you come together not for the better but for the worse.
verses.en_bbe: But in giving you this order, there is one thing about which I am not pleased: it is that when you come together it is not for the better but for the worse.

verses.en: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
verses.pt: Porque, em primeiro lugar, eu ouço que, quando vos ajuntais, há divisões entre vós; e em parte eu acredito.
verses.en_web: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.
verses.en_bbe: For first of all, it has come to my ears that when you come together in the church, there are divisions among you, and I take the statement to be true in part.

verses.en: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.
verses.pt: Porque é necessário que haja diferenças de opinião entre vós, para que os que são aprovados sejam evidenciados entre vós.
verses.en_web: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.
verses.en_bbe: For divisions are necessary among you, in order that those who have God's approval may be clearly seen among you.

verses.en: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord’s supper.
verses.pt: Quando, pois, vós vos reunis, não é para comer da ceia do Senhor;
verses.en_web: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.
verses.en_bbe: But now, when you come together, it is not possible to take the holy meal of the Lord:

verses.en: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
verses.pt: Porque cada um, comendo antes, toma sua própria ceia; e um fica com fome, e outro fica bêbado.
verses.en_web: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.
verses.en_bbe: For when you take your food, everyone takes his meal before the other; and one has not enough food, and another is the worse for drink.

verses.en: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
verses.pt: Por acaso não tendes casas para comer e para beber? Ou desprezais a Igreja de Deus, e envergonhais os que não têm? Que vos direi? Eu vos elogiarei? Nisto eu não vos elogio.
verses.en_web: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly, and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.
verses.en_bbe: What? have you not houses to take your meals in? or have you no respect for the church of God, putting the poor to shame? What am I to say to you? am I to give you praise? certainly not.

verses.en: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:
verses.pt: Porque eu recebi do Senhor o que também vos entreguei; que o Senhor Jesus, na noite em que foi traído, tomou o pão;
verses.en_web: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.
verses.en_bbe: For it was handed down to me from the Lord, as I gave it to you, that the Lord Jesus, on the night when Judas was false to him, took bread,

verses.en: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
verses.pt: E tendo dado graças, o partiu, e disse: Tomai, comei; isto é o meu corpo, que é partido por vós; fazei isto em memória de mim.
verses.en_web: When he had given thanks, he broke it, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”
verses.en_bbe: And when it had been broken with an act of praise, he said, This is my body which is for you: do this in memory of me.

verses.en: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.
verses.pt: Semelhantemente também, depois de cear, tomou o copo, dizendo: Este copo é o novo Testamento em meu sangue. Fazei isto todas as vezes que o beberdes, em memória de mim.
verses.en_web: In the same way he also took the cup, after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”
verses.en_bbe: In the same way, with the cup, after the meal, he said, This cup is the new testament in my blood: do this, whenever you take it, in memory of me.

verses.en: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord’s death till he come.
verses.pt: Porque todas as vezes que comerdes deste pão, e beberdes deste copo, anunciai a morte do Senhor, até que ele venha.
verses.en_web: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.
verses.en_bbe: For whenever you take the bread and the cup you give witness to the Lord's death till he comes.

verses.en: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
verses.pt: Portanto quem comer deste pão, ou beber deste copo do Senhor indignamente, será culpado do corpo e do sangue do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: If, then, anyone takes the bread or the cup of the Lord in the wrong spirit, he will be responsible for the body and blood of the Lord.

verses.en: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.
verses.pt: Portanto examine-se cada um a si mesmo, e assim coma deste pão, e beba deste copo.
verses.en_web: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread, and drink of the cup.
verses.en_bbe: But let no man take of the bread and the cup without testing himself.

verses.en: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord’s body.
verses.pt: Porque quem come e bebe indignamente, para si mesmo come e bebe condenação, não discernindo o corpo do Senhor.
verses.en_web: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself, if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.
verses.en_bbe: For a man puts himself in danger, if he takes part in the holy meal without being conscious that it is the Lord's body.

verses.en: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.
verses.pt: Por esta causa há entre vós muitos fracos e doentes, e muitos que dormem.
verses.en_web: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause a number of you are feeble and ill, and a number are dead.

verses.en: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
verses.pt: Porque se nós julgássemos a nós mesmos, não seríamos julgados.
verses.en_web: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.
verses.en_bbe: But if we were true judges of ourselves, punishment would not come on us.

verses.en: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.
verses.pt: Mas quando somos julgados, somos repreendidos pelo Senhor; para que não sejamos condenados com o mundo.
verses.en_web: But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
verses.en_bbe: But if punishment does come, it is sent by the Lord, so that we may be safe when the world is judged.

verses.en: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.
verses.pt: Portanto, meus irmãos, quando vos ajuntardes para comer, esperai uns aos outros.
verses.en_web: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
verses.en_bbe: So then, my brothers, when you come together to the holy meal of the Lord, let there be waiting for one another.

verses.en: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.
verses.pt: Porém se alguém tiver fome, coma em casa; para que não vos ajunteis para sofrerdes julgamento. Quanto às demais coisas, as ordenarei quando vier.
verses.en_web: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.
verses.en_bbe: If any man is in need of food, let him take his meal in his house; so that you may not come together to your damage. And the rest I will put in order when I come.
